I noticed your restaurant & banquet has exceptional 4.8★ reviews in Phulwari Sharif, Patna, but currently uses a Swiggy link instead of a dedicated direct-booking website.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct banquet inquiry, table reservation, aur menu showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/foodiemall

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi The Foodie Mall team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant aur banquet ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.
